meta.title: The Caspian Sea Is Never a Sea?

features.name: Caspian Sea
features._note: Interior ring of Natural Earth 10m land polygons (the Caspian is a hole in Eurasia's land mass).

scenes.narration: This is the Caspian Sea, and its name might be the biggest lie on the map.
It has no connection to any ocean, which technically makes it the largest lake on Earth, almost exactly the size of Germany.
Five countries share its shores: Russia, Kazakhstan, Turkmenistan, Iran, and Azerbaijan.
And beneath its floor lie almost fifty billion barrels of oil. Off the coast of Azerbaijan, there's even a whole town built on stilts, far out at sea.
So the name matters. If it's a sea, each country owns the water off its own coast, and Iran gets only about thirteen percent. If it's a lake, it's split equally, twenty percent each.
After more than twenty years of arguing, all five signed a deal in Aktau in twenty eighteen, declaring the Caspian neither a sea nor a lake. It's just the Caspian.

elements.text: Not a sea. Not a lake.
